summary: A cast-iron caisson lighthouse of 1884 on Little Cormorant Rock off Sakonnet Point, saved from demolition by Little Compton and restored by its Friends; relit in 1997.

lens.where: Maine Lighthouse Museum, Rockland (most of it); a small section at the Little Compton Historical Society

access.note: Offshore on Little Cormorant Rock; owned by Friends of Sakonnet Lighthouse; tower closed.

notes_for_editor: Durfee: USLHS 1920-1944 vs Friends 'became principal keeper in 1921, 20 years'; story states both. Lighthousefriends calls the 1924 damage Durfee's watch, but the Bulletin names no keeper. Chadwick appears only on Lighthousefriends (no year, not in USLHS). Friends: relit ceremony 22 March 1997 vs LF 19 March. Current characteristic colour unresolved (Friends: red; record: white). The 1891-92 volume date for the stair work is uncertain (LF says 1892); scan p.412, printed p.63 unconfirmed. Elevation: record 20.0 m vs NRHP 66 ft (about 20.1 m) combined height. NRHP listing year (1983 per record) not read in a source, so the story gives only the 1982 nomination date. Nils Nelson's later death (Lighthousefriends) deliberately omitted. No newspapers found in Chronicling America for 1884-90. Roster lines were taken from the USLHS tool's printed output; only the 'other' USCG line is non-keeper. Corpus LHB volumes begin 1891 so the 1882-84 construction years rest on the NRHP nomination.
